headline: Conversion rate dropped uniformly across regions, but we can't confirm why.
body: The decline is broad-based, not concentrated in any one region — all four regions fell by roughly the same amount. Marketing spend and tracked sessions both show weak co-movement, not enough to point to either as a driver. No corroborating evidence was retrieved to support a specific cause. The uniform, diffuse pattern suggests something upstream or systemic rather than a regional or campaign-specific issue.
what_could_change: Evidence tying the drop to a specific campaign change, tracking issue, or funnel step would let us confirm a cause.
caveats: Confidence is low because coverage and supporting evidence are both thin, even though the movement itself is statistically clear.
clarifying_question: Did any tracking, attribution, or funnel/checkout change roll out across all regions in July 2026?
escalation_brief: Conversion rate fell 15.7% below trend uniformly across all regions in July 2026 with no clear driver identified; recommend checking for a global tracking or funnel change before reallocating budget.
